mainEntity.name: Are there specific considerations for mothers who are breastfeeding while engaging in postpartum fitness?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, breastfeeding mothers should pay attention to hydration and calorie intake to maintain milk supply. Wearing a supportive sports bra is also important for comfort. While exercise is generally safe and does not negatively impact milk supply for most, some mothers might experience temporary changes in milk flavor due to lactic acid buildup after intense workouts. Staying well-hydrated and nursing before exercising can help manage these considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Breastfeeding mothers should prioritize hydration, adequate calorie intake, and a supportive sports bra. Exercise is generally safe, but monitor milk supply and comfort.
